plan.desired_state: A 9:16 story video presenting the whole blog screenshot, with narration reading its first paragraph in English; preserve the remaining content.

steps.why: Read the supplied screenshot to obtain the exact paragraph needed for narration.

params.extra: Return the first body paragraph, excluding the title and navigation; provide an English translation only if necessary.
params.prompt_or_change: Transcribe the first paragraph of the blog post accurately for English narration.

steps.why: Adapt the supplied image rather than generate a replacement.

params.prompt_or_change: Place the complete screenshot within a 9:16 story canvas using unobtrusive complementary padding; preserve all original text and imagery without cropping or rewriting.

steps.why: Create the requested spoken reading; its duration will determine the story length.

params.extra: Language: English; voice: clear, natural neutral English narrator; read only the extracted paragraph.
params.prompt_or_change: Read the English first-paragraph transcript naturally and faithfully.

steps.why: Combine the narration and reformatted screenshot into a single story clip.

params.extra: Set the clip duration to the exact narration duration; keep the image static and fully visible, with no added music or text.
